🇲🇽⚖️ <u>27 CONSTITUTIONAL + 76 LEGAL REFORMS: THE CONSTITUTION BELONGS TO THE PEOPLE AGAIN</u>

Neoliberalism spent decades hollowing out the Constitution. The 4T is refilling it. Presidential legal counsel Luisa María Alcalde tallied 27 constitutional and 76 legal reforms that "recover the social sense of the Constitution": the 40-hour work week, welfare and pensions turned into enforceable rights, Indigenous and Afro-Mexican peoples recognized as subjects of public law with their own budgets, state control locked over Pemex and the CFE, and a ban on transgenic maize.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>DEA TRIES TO SPLIT MEXICO'S CABINET — HITS A WALL</u>

Washington's oldest trick: praise some, smear others, break the ranks. When the DEA's director lavished praise on some of Mexico's security chiefs while insinuating others colluded with cartels, Sheinbaum named it: "They seek to weaken governments by dividing us internally." Her verdict — "they hit a wall." Coordination happens on Mexico's terms or not at all: "they've understood our sovereign position."
banner: DEA'S DIVIDE TACTIC HITS A WALL

text:
🇲🇽🛢️ <u>MEXICO MOVES TO CHOKE OFF FUEL-TAX FRAUD</u>

No new taxes — just no more theft. In the 2027 economic package landing September 9, Sheinbaum will make the fuel tax (IEPS) traceable from port to pump: QR codes on every tanker logging origin, route and depot so the SAT can cross-check imported volumes against the tax actually paid. "We can now know how much imported fuel arrives and where it ends up," she said. The target is huachicol fiscal — the customs-fraud racket that has bled billions from the treasury.
banner: MEXICO: QR TRACKING VS FUEL FRAUD

text:
🇲🇽🏭 <u>MEXICO'S IMPORT-SUBSTITUTION MACHINE IS RUNNING</u>

While Washington threatens tariffs, Mexico builds. The Second Government Report shows US$987.5 million in fresh investment already approved under Sheinbaum's Plan México — 148 of 173 projects greenlit between September 2025 and June 2026, across autos, pharma, mining, chemicals and agroindustry. The strategy is blunt: make at home what the country used to import, and crack the world's ten biggest economies by 2030.
